title: ReceiptPayload
description: RFC 8785 JCS-Canonicalized Cryptographic Receipt Schema v1.0 for SMAOS/STAR Protocol

version.description: Semantic version of the receipt payload specification.

action_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the tool dispatch / action.

leaf_index.description: 0-based leaf ordinal of this receipt in the Merkle audit log.

tree_size.description: Total number of committed leaves in the Merkle tree at checkpoint time (leaf_index < tree_size).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of receipt issuance.

intent_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical action input / tool parameters.

root_hash.description: SHA-256 Merkle root digest over tree_size committed leaves.

inclusion_proof.description: RFC 9162 Merkle audit path hashes demonstrating leaf membership.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature hex string over RFC 8785 JCS-canonicalized receipt payload.

signer_pubkey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key hex of the authorized attestor.
